_readme: Mock data added to the DB constant of RW-Rent.dc.html for the Delete records feature.
Nothing else in DB was changed. Rows that already existed and are only referenced here are
listed under existingRowsRelieadOn, so the fixtures can be built on the same shape.
Timestamps are written as hoursFromNow: at(-24*40) in the prototype means 40 days ago. The
prototype's at(h) returns an ISO instant h hours from load; atRaw()/payload() render the same
instant with an explicit offset (2026-08-23T11:57:51.621+00:00) for raw audit payloads.
Enum ids follow the existing E maps: assignment status 1 Active, 2 Ended, 3 Cancelled,
4 Planned; customer type 1 private person, 2 business; authorizationType 1 named driver,
2 company-authorized; stopReason 4 Assignment ended; interruption reason 1 Customer request;

vehicles._why: Ready vehicle: inactive and nothing refers to it. The only unreferenced inactive vehicle.

customers._why: Ready customer: inactive, no rental assignment refers to it. Also supplies the driver link that blocks driver d9.

drivers._why: Driver blocked by a driver authorization (z7, on rental a7).
Driver blocked by a customer's driver link (customer cu9), with no authorization at all.

authorizations._why: Second authorization on the ended rental a7, so one rental carries two authorizations and one interruption. Keyed by rentalAssignmentId, as in DB.authorizations.

a7.note: Second driver added for the northern route.

audit._why: Recently deleted, row 1: a vehicle, by the System Administrator. Its entity no longer exists, which is the point of recordLabel.
Recently deleted, row 2: a rental with parts, by a Fleet Manager, reason with a note. Drives the Deleted authorizations and Deleted interruptions panels.
audit.reason: Practice or test record — made while teaching a new colleague.

audit._why: Recently deleted, row 3: a driver, by a third person, third reason.

existingRowsReliedOn._why: Already in DB before this feature. Listed so the fixture set covers every state without adding more rows.
existingRowsReliedOn.a11: Cancelled rental with no parts — the Ready rental assignment (770 HDV · Daugava Construction)
existingRowsReliedOn.a7: Ended rental, now with two authorizations (z6, z7) and one interruption (i4) — 400 NDP · Roberts Liepins
existingRowsReliedOn.a6: Active rental with an open interruption (i3) — 204 JLM · Anete Kalnina. Its z5 is the only open authorization, so z5 is the Blocked authorization
existingRowsReliedOn.z6: Stopped authorization on a7 — a Ready authorization
existingRowsReliedOn.i1, i4: Ended interruptions — the two Ready interruptions
existingRowsReliedOn.v5, v8: Inactive vehicles with one rental assignment each — Blocked vehicles
existingRowsReliedOn.cu5: Inactive customer with one rental assignment — Blocked customer
existingRowsReliedOn.d6: Inactive driver with no references — Ready driver
existingRowsReliedOn.u1, u2, u4: The three actors of the seeded deletions (System Administrator, Fleet Manager, third user)
